assessment: The size concentration of seam rework and the customer corner mismatch suggest two distinguishable fitting problems. Neither cause is established. Missing stage timings and width shrinkage prevent a justified claim that either opening will achieve 38 of 40 first placements and a median of 32 minutes.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: sew and check the first ordered cover in each size before releasing that size's remaining cutting, using measured deviations to assess the common allowance.
openings.delta: Replace whole-batch cutting with a size-specific feedback point; the first covers remain saleable batch units.
openings.prediction: If the common allowance drives rework, comparable cut-to-sewn dimensional errors should recur by size, and correcting the demonstrated error should reduce later same-size seam reopening. Inconsistent errors would weaken this explanation.
openings.probe: Record actual cut dimensions, sewn dimensions, operator, cutting direction, design and stage times for the first unit of each size and subsequent units. Release any revised cutting card only after checking fit, five-cycle wash survival and a stock layout with no more than 8% waste by area; count trial and coordination labor in batch working time.
assumptions: A usable correction can fit the purchased stock and delivery window.
The first unit provides useful information despite operator and cloth variation.

openings.claim: Customer table dimensions and corner profiles may explain installation failures that the reference-table check misses.
openings.delta: Validate the order-to-actual-table match before treating reference-table fit as sufficient.
openings.prediction: Among covers passing the reference check, customer placement difficulty should concentrate where measured dimensions or corner profiles differ from the reference, rather than solely by cover size.
openings.probe: Use the six willing customers to obtain actual tabletop dimensions and corner outlines, prioritizing nominal-only orders where possible. Pair those measurements with reference fit and observed first placement. Record dimension mismatch separately from corner mismatch to distinguish their associations.
assumptions: Customers can supply sufficiently accurate measurements within three weeks.
Measurement and observation effort fits the existing budget and is included in working time.
